archivedEvents.title: From the Deep: In the Wake of Drexciya with Ayana V. Jackson
archivedEvents.event_name: From the Deep: In the Wake of Drexciya with Ayana V. Jackson
archivedEvents.address: 6393 NW Marine Dr, Vancouver, BC V6T 1Z2
archivedEvents.full_address: 6393 NW Marine Dr, Vancouver, BC V6T 1Z2
archivedEvents.description: Inspired by the mythic underwater realm of Detroit techno duo Drexciya, artist Ayana V. Jackson creates an immersive feminist, Pan-African aquatopia populated by Afro-Atlantic water spirits. Through large-scale photography, video installations, and animation, this contemplative exhibition reimagines the Atlantic Ocean from a historical site of trauma into a transformative space of speculative fiction.

archivedEvents.title: 52ND STREET (Billy Joel Tribute) / RUNNIN DOWN A DREAM (Tom Petty tribute)
archivedEvents.description: The Roxy Cabaret presents a dual tribute night featuring 52nd Street playing Billy Joel and Runnin Down a Dream performing Tom Petty classics. Admission covers the full evening with all ticket proceeds supporting the bands.

archivedEvents.title: To Be Or Not To Be
archivedEvents.description: Ernst Lubitsch's 1942 screwball masterpiece stars Jack Benny and Carole Lombard as husband-and-wife thespians caught up in a dangerous spy plot in Nazi-occupied Warsaw. Balancing political satire, romance, and slapstick, this classic film delivers a daring comic high-wire act of urgency and suspense.

archivedEvents.title: The Mad Dog of Europe
archivedEvents.description: The Mad Dog of Europe screens at the VIFF Centre's Lochmaddy Studio Theatre in downtown Vancouver. This cinema screening offers single-visit tickets starting at $15 for adults.

archivedEvents.title: The Mortal Storm
archivedEvents.description: Screening of The Mortal Storm presented at the VIFF Centre's Lochmaddy Studio Theatre. Single admission tickets start at $15.00 CAD for adults.

archivedEvents.title: Three Comrades
archivedEvents.description: Screening of Three Comrades at the VIFF Centre - Lochmaddy Studio Theatre in Vancouver. Presented as part of the Vancouver International Film Festival year-round cinema programming.

archivedEvents.title: Just Joni
archivedEvents.description: Brixxhouse Arts and the Rio Theatre celebrate Joni Mitchell's 83rd birthday with a live music and multimedia tribute featuring iconic songs, interviews, and artwork. Performed by a full band and vocalists, the evening pays heartfelt homage to the legendary Canadian artist.

archivedEvents.title: Being Heumann (Free Community Screening)
archivedEvents.description: Directed by Academy Award winner Siân Heder, Being Heumann tells the true story of disability rights activist Judy Heumann and the historic 1977 occupation of a federal building. Presented as a free community screening by Apple and RANGE Magazine in partnership with local cultural organizations.

archivedEvents.title: Cheap Thrills Dance Party
archivedEvents.description: Cheap Thrills Dance Party takes over the Fox Cabaret on the first Friday of every month, spinning 90s to modern hits alongside cheap cover and drink specials. General admission is 19+ with tickets available online or at the door.

archivedEvents.title: Guilty Pleasures: 90s-Now Dance Party
archivedEvents.description: Guilty Pleasures returns to the Fox Cabaret featuring 90s, 00s, 10s, and current pop anthems from Spice Girls to BTS. Resident Common People DJs Adam Fink and Bryan Sea spin alongside special guests for a high-energy dance party.
archivedEvents.artist: Common People DJs Adam Fink and Bryan Sea
lineup: Common People DJs Adam Fink and Bryan Sea

archivedEvents.title: Centre Stage
archivedEvents.description: Stanley Kwan's 1991 biographical masterpiece chronicles the tragic final years of Chinese silent film icon Ruan Lingyu, played by Maggie Cheung. This 35th anniversary engagement presents a stunning 4K restoration exploring fame, artistic identity, and historical melodrama.

archivedEvents.title: Tokyo Melody: A Film About Ryuichi Sakamoto
archivedEvents.description: A restored 1985 documentary by Elizabeth Lennard capturing electronic-music pioneer Ryuichi Sakamoto during the recording of Ongaku Zukan amid the bustling streets of Bubble-era Tokyo. Screened at The Cinematheque in Japanese with English subtitles.

archivedEvents.title: When I Walk
archivedEvents.description: Winner of an Emmy for Outstanding Informational Programming, When I Walk is an intimate autobiographical documentary following filmmaker Jason DaSilva as he navigates life after being diagnosed with multiple sclerosis. Hosted by Harry Killas in support of ECU 100, the screening will be followed by a reflection and Q&A with DaSilva.

archivedEvents.title: Free First Friday Nights
archivedEvents.description: Experience the Vancouver Art Gallery during Free First Friday Nights presented by BMO with complimentary admission from 4 to 8 PM. Visitors can explore current exhibitions and gallery collections with advance reserved tickets.

archivedEvents.title: Artist Talk: Jean Shin
archivedEvents.description: Artist Jean Shin explores the intersection of technology, material consumption, and environmental change in conjunction with the exhibition Future Geographies. The talk is followed by a conversation with UBC professors Dr. Sara Ghebremusse and Dr. Milind Kandlikar.

archivedEvents.title: Remembrance Day Sunday
archivedEvents.description: Join the Sunday morning Remembrance Day service honouring those who died in combat and war while praying for lasting peace. Featuring piper Cameron Bonar, trumpeter Brandon Walker, and music by the Sanctuary Singers.

archivedEvents.title: Climate Talks: Hold Fast: How to Heal Personal and Climate Grief
archivedEvents.description: Wendy Sarkissian launches three books in her Twilight River Trilogy, exploring personal and climate grief in a time of climate breakdown. The community event takes place in the Chapel at St. Andrew's-Wesley United Church.

archivedEvents.title: Cirque du Soleil: Luzia
archivedEvents.description: Join us as we take you on a journey into the colorful and fantastical world of LUZIA, set in a make-believe Mexico, where you will be treated to stunning visual surprises and breathtaking acrobatic performances. LUZIA deftly guides you through the locations, people, and sounds of both classical and contemporary Mexico, taking you from urban locations like an old movie set and a smoke-filled dance hall to the beach and barren desert.

archivedEvents.title: Christopher Tin's The Lost Birds
archivedEvents.description: Experience Christopher Tin's Grammy Award-winning choral tribute honoring extinct bird species and the fragile beauty of our natural world, set to the poignant verse of Emily Dickinson, Christina Rossetti, and Edna St. Vincent Millay. Led by conductor Cathrie Yuen, the Vancouver Bach Choir joins the Microcosmos Quartet, harp, and percussion for an evocative concert that also features works by Iman Habibi and Andrew Balfour.

archivedEvents.transitInfo: Vancouver City Centre Station (Canada Line) or Granville Station (Expo Line) ~4-5 blocks away; TransLink Granville NightBus and bus routes 4, 7, 10, 14, 16, 50 stopping along Granville St and Seymour/Howe corridors
